name: Kagerou
source:
As the Edo period comes to an end, civilizations are sure to clash. 

An isolated place. 

A forgotten village. 

A mountain where a god resides. 

This, is a tale of confluences in a time of change. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE141149.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
江户时代即将结束，文明之间的冲突不可避免。

一个与世隔绝的地方。

一个被遗忘的村庄。

一座有神明居住的山。

这是一个发生在变革时代、关于各种交汇的故事。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE141149.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
